Book Now Treatments Our Services Injectables Lasers Medical Aesthetics Spa & Beauty Biote HRT Peptide Therapy Explore treatments Two Locations Falmouth & South Portland , Maine Portland, Maine’s Trusted Medical Spa Since 2005 Rejuvenations Medi-Spa has been Maine’s trusted destination for medical aesthetics since 2005. Our expert team specializes in injectables, dermal fillers, laser skin resurfacing, microneedling, peels, regenerative skin therapies and integrative wellness to help you look and feel your best. We also offer spa and beauty treatments, DiamondGlow® facials, and medical-grade skincare to refresh and maintain your healthiest skin. Start your journey with a free consultation.
